content: Kasiyel Kofal Sabbath
Te ssulay mo wol miril, irel sew Sabbath, ngo Jesus mo mokwe re dabeyal re dedarloh luwul tot milayel wheat. Mokwe re dabeyal resa ffichfich sibol wheat kowe resa mongoy bo resa rol mesel koloh.
Yodwe Pharisees kowe re wiri molwe re foforu ngo resa kangalu Jesus bo, “Kemahoy, ye tafel ngal Hatobtob we yach le meka re dabeyem rebe foru tappel mala resa foru rall Sabbath!”
Jesus yesa hatefali le ye sor bo, “Ha ted yawli mwo kaptal molwe David ye foru irel yodwe iy mo mokwe choluwal re mesel yar koloh iyang?
Iy mo mokwe choluwal re bulong lal imw we imwel Deus, re sala hangi flowa we re tap maligach ngal Deus, le ye tafel ngal Hatobtob bo halachog temarong ka mele ma yoh le rebe ma hangi.
Ha ted yawli mo irel Hatobtob we yael Moses, le pangal Sabbath ngo temarong ka rema hatawsi Hatobtobol Sabbath mo lal Templum we, ngo re tema tayikof iyang?
Ibe kangalugmi le yor mele ye mel iga le ye palleng pelal mo imoal Templum we.
Babior we ye Santus ye sor bo, ‘Mala idipli ila momayel hagiyeg, ngo te mael kala hama tape maligach.’ Hare ha gola fael mele, ngo ha towe hatugulu yar tayikof sibis le tor mele re hadre;
bo mala Layur Retalop mele iy Samol le ye lamli Sabbath.”
Mal We Ye Mes Sere Paol
Jesus ye chuy mo loboswe yesa loh irel sew imwel ttey kowe,

le ye mel semal mal iyang le ye mes sere mala paol. Ye mel tot yarmat lobowe le re luluwaley bo rebe ffaeg derel Jesus. Iwe resa kasiya bo, “Ifa sengal ye tayikof ngal Hatobtob le yach le sibe hachuchuy tomay mo uwor yarmat rall Sabbath?”
Jesus yesa hatefali ngo sa sor bo, “Itey semal hami le hare ye halsemal lol saaf ngo la wol Sabbath, ngo yesa ppunglong lal sew lib le ye yod, ngo iy bela te bidiy ye bela yetedah?
Ye palleng pelal semal yarmat mo imol semal saaf! Ila Hatobtob we yach ye teladgich le sibe tipingi semal wol Sabbath.”
Iwe sa kangalu mal we ye mes sere paol bo, “Hawweleloh mala poam.” Mal we ye haweleloh molwe paol sala momayloh le sa tappel chog rewe sere.
Iwe Pharisees kowe resa loh re sala luluwaley mele rebe foru ngo sa yoh le rebe llimeseloh Jesus.
Yeramtala Deus Ye Hatugulu Bo Yal Boy
Yodwe Jesus yela rongrong kofal molwe resa luluwaley rebe faor ngali, ngo sa chuy mo loboswe yesa loh. Ye cholop yarmat le resa dabey. Ye hachuya yar tomay panger rechoka re tomay,
iwe ngo Jesus yesa kangalur bo tor semal le rebe kangalu kofal.
Ye faor mele bo yebe llahloh le ye katos mokwe yalol Deus we profeta Isaiah ye sor bo:

content.text: le ihachangi, ngo ye fel depey irel.
Ibele fangdiy Espritu Santus la yai uwol,
ngo ye bele kapta loh mekla isa hatugulu ngalir chol sere mo sere lam.
Ye towe hapaliyel hare ye ttawul ngalir yarmat,
hare ye foloy fedal lal yalap le be palleng yalol.
Ngo ye towe hopiyloh seyal fadil le sa bbordiy,
hare ye gululoh bbulul sew habul le ye yaliyel mala bulal.
Yebe tabochog yal yengang yee, la hola yodla pangal formel ngo sa fel.
Ngo pangal yarmat ngo re bele yetedah deper uwol.”

content: Jesus Mo Beelzebul
Iwe ngo tot yarmat resa hasidoh semal mal irel Jesus. Mal we ila ye metafis ngo tema hapatpat bo yor moniyan uwol. Jesus sa hachuya yael mal we tomay, iwe sala yoh le ye kapatpat ngo ye wiri formel.
Panger rechokwe we ngo resa lluwdah irel molwe Jesus sa foru. Iwe resa kasiy le re sor bo, “Te iye mal we Lol David?”
Yodwe Pharisees kowe re la rongrong molwe ngo resa sor bo, “Yema hachuchuy moniyan, bo Beelzebul le yar tamol mele ye fang kkelal bo be foru.”

Jesus ye gola luluwal kowe yar, iwe yesa kangalur bo, “Chol sew fulu le rebe harere resa rol fedeg fengal, ila towe ssulay yar mel. Ngo sew haplom hare sew haleng le rebe harere resa rol fedeg fengal ila rebe taroproploh.
Hare chol sere re fedeg ngal chol sere mo irel mala Lamliyel Satan, ila ngo sa faesul mehalhal mala lamliyal, ngo towol ssulay ngo bele taroproploh.

Hami ha sor bo iy ma hachuchuy moniyan bo fal mala Beelzebul mele ye fang kkeley bo iy be foru. Ila ngo itey le ye fang kkeler mekla wochilami bo rebe hachuchuy moniyan? Mekla re foforu mele sa hatosiya le hami ha tabung!
Yeb, te ila sengal, te Beelzebul mele ye fang kkeley bo Espritu Santus le yael Deus mele ye fang kkeley bo ibe hachuchuy moniyan. Ila mala sa hatosiya le mala Lamliyel Deus ila sa faesul mel iremi.
“Tor semal le be yoh ngali le be hatawsilong imwel semal mal le ye kkel, yesa hasiloh mekla lital. Yebe moal fargu mwo mal we ye kkel, ila ngo sa moch yoh le be hachwera lital imw we.
“Semal le te ppiliyey, ila ngo ye hatohar ngalyey; semal le yete tipingiyey irel hatteyel yarmat, ila ngo iy ye ketaropropar yarmat.

Ila fal le ikangalugmi bo: te tugul sew tayikof le semal yarmat ye foru hare ye sor hare re hapatpat tayikof loh irel Deus, ngo be chuy molfidel; iwe ngo semal le yebe hapatpat tayikof loh irel Espritu Santus, ngo towe chuy molfidil.

Semal le ye kapta sew formel le ye hattohar ngal mala Layur Retalop, ngo be chuy fael molfid we sa foru: ngo semal le ye kapta sew formel le ye hattohar ngal Espritu Santus, ngo towe chuy fael molfid we sa foru — igla sa loh le tor siyal.
Sehay Ire Mo Mekla Uwal
“Hare be momay uwal sehay ire ila ngo ire la ila ye momay. Hare be tayikof ire la, ngo be tayikof mekla uwal. Sima gola kofal sehay ire mo irel igegel mekla uwal.
Hami parchoyoh kala — be ifa sengal yami kapta mekla ye momay le hami ha rol tayikof? Bo meka sima kaptawey mo irel yewach, ila ikla mekla ye ssoeg lal bulach.
Semal yarmat le ye momay ye hasidoh mekla ye momay mo irel momay kala ye kekateyili; ngo semal le ye tayikof ila yebe hasidoh mekla ye tayikof mo irel tayikof kala ye kekateyili.
“Be tugul lal dipmi le bela hola yodla Rael Tatelal Hapatpat, ngo semal ngo ye bele hamdefa fael pangal hapatpat kala ye kapta le tor pelal.
Mekla ha sor mele rebe tapeli irel yar hatugulu kofmi hare ha bung hare ha tabung.”
Re Kangalu Jesus Yebe Foru Sew Kkemal
Iwe ngo tot mokwe sensel Hatobtob we mo tot Pharisees re kangalu Jesus bo, “Sensey, ha dipli habe wurug le hobe foru sew kkemal.”

Jesus sa kangalur bo, “Yesa kkel hemas tayikofer yarmat fael mwole, bo re tay talenga yalol Deus! Ha dipli habe wiri yai foru sew kkemal? Yeb! Kkemal la be yoh le habe wiri ila tappel kkemal we Deus ye foru ngali profeta Jonah.
Jonah iwe solral yal mel lal siyal raswe, le be ila sengal mala Layur Retalop le be wol solral le be mel fael bol.

Yodla Rael Tatelal Hapatpat, ngo yarmetal Nineveh re bele sudah ngo re bele kapta yami tayikof, bo fael mala ir re tagul tang molfidir irel yodwe re rongrong yael Jonah foloy; ngo ibe kangalugmi le yor mele ye mel iga le ye tagiyet mo imol Jonah.

Yodla Rael Tatelal Hapatpat, ngo Queen we wol Sheba bele sudah ngo bele sor yami tayikof. Bo fal mala ye sala budoh mo wol mala faluyal irel King Solomon bo be talenga yal folol harepiy. Ngo ibe kangalugmi le yor mele ye mel iga, le ye tagiyet mo imol Solomon!
Yael Moniyan We Tefaeldoh
“Yodla be chuy semal moniyan mo uwol semal yarmat, ngo bele loh sala ffag fedal solboy le be hasoso mo iyang. Hare tor solbos le ye wiri,
ngo bele iy chog yal sor bo, ‘Ibele tefael loh irel molwe imwey. Iwe yesa tefael loh irel molwe imwal sala wiri le tor le ye mel iyang, ngo ye kilil, ngo pangal formel ngo ye fel igegal.

Yesa loh sala fesangurdoh fismol moniyan le sa kkel tot yar tayikof mo imol, resa budoh paoy lobowe. Iwe ye bele la paoy yaramtawe le bele kkel yal tayikof mo imol molwe metamo. Iye mele bele wel ngalir rechokla re tayikof raleka.”
Molwe Sil Jesus Mo Mokwe Wolbisil
Jesus ye chil kapatpat ngalir yarmat, ngo resa budoh mokwe wol bisil mo molwe sil. Resa su ligtam ngo resa kasiy hare be yoh le rebe hapatpat ngal Jesus.
Iwe semal mo lobowe yesa kangalu Jesus bo, “Kalloh, molwe solom mo mokwe wol bisim ikla re su ligtam le re dipli rebe hapatpat ngalug.”
Jesus sa hatefali ngalir ngo sa sor bo, “Itey mele seley? Itey mele bisiy?”
Iwe yesa sid ngalir mokwe re dabeyal ngo sa sor bo, “Ha kaladoh! Ika meka seley mo wol bisiy!
Semal le ye foru mekla mala Temay wol laeng ye dipli bo yebe foru, ngo ila mala bisiy, mo mengay, mo seley.”
